_about: Corrections to library cases that the borrowed-request check found sending the same request as a sibling (caseLibrary.ts borrowedRequests). Kept apart from api-cases.json, which scripts/build-cases.mjs regenerates. replace: the request the case should send. runAsWritten: the request is right; the sibling is about a different state, or a company-setting gate decides where it applies. needsState: the request is right but needs a starting state the run cannot build.

EDGE-BID-049.preconditions: Session: the invited VENDOR user of {{vendorUuid}} (not the buyer). {{pricingTradeUuid}} is the journey's own pricing stage, bid_end_time passed.
